content.value: A single link robot with a rotary joint is motionless at $\theta _ { 0 } = 5 ^ { \circ }$ It is desired to move the joint in a smooth manner to $\theta _ { \mathrm { { g } } } = 4 0 ^ { \circ }$ in 2s. (i) Find the coefficients of a cubic polynomial that accomplishes the motion and brings the manipulator to rest at goal. Plot the position, velocity, and acceleration of the joint as a function of time. (ii) Consider, there is a via point at $\mathsf { \nabla } \theta _ { \nabla } = 1 5 ^ { \circ } ;$ and each segment lasts 1 s. Derive the equations of motion and plot the position, velocity, and acceleration graphs.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2022
